properties.name: kraken.messaging.store.jdbc.dialect
properties.description: The SQL message store's dialect: postgresql or mysql. Unset: detected from the DataSource's database product name.

properties.name: kraken.messaging.store.jdbc.purge-interval
properties.description: How often the SQL message store deletes what its retentions (kraken.messaging.*.retention) let go, the expired dead letters and the passed dispatch leases. Zero turns the purge off.
